data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 reduces to the direct positional product 9*9*8=648 demonstrated in SRC_005: both compute the identical set of three-digit numbers with pairwise distinct digits, so the complement subtraction 900-252=648 is arithmetically equivalent to the positional multiplication. It is refuted if SRC_005's counting of 9*9*8 miscounts the distinct set, or if the 252 complement in SRC_002 is not exactly the complement of the 648 counted positionally, meaning the two methods count different sets.
